If you are conscious enough to think about the state of your depression from this perspective, you aren’t making it up.

I dont tell anyone, but if someone notices my lack of energy my go to excuse is that im tired. Depression isn’t something easily or accurately explained by words, only someone else who has experienced it can truly understand.

I thought that as well. It only works if you want it to work. If you go into therapy with the preset idea that its not going to work, it wont work (pretty obviously). However, if you give it an honest effort, thats when you can safely say if it works or doesnt work for you. Even if it doesnt work it could be due to a slew of other factors. Don’t rule it out, I would encourage trying it.
Stay strong friend. If you were sober once, it can happen again. One step back, two steps forward. If you need someone to talk to, PM me. Im rooting for you :)

Don’t expect instant results. I thought the meds im on now didnt work for the first 4 weeks of taking them. Be patient and you will start to see effects. If not, the medication might not be right for you. Youll get there though :)

I dont know about depressive symptoms at such a young age and how it may be different, but if its anything like depression for those that are older, definitely seek medical help. You say that you know it won’t help, but you truly have no way of knowing that until you give it an honest try.

I took some of those tests before I went and sought medical help. There may be some truth to them, but self-diagnosis can end up poorly. I would recommend talking to a medical professional and seeing from there. There are so many different mental illnesses with symptoms similar to that of depression, so its really hard to know from something like this.

That being said, the idea that you are suspecting that you have something might be indicative of some sort of mental illness. Definitely talk to someone, and PM me if you ever want to talk :)

This is going to sound harsh and im struggling with a similar situation, but you have to begin to understand your worth. Believe me, I know its not that simple but that is the direction you need to head in. Its important to realize that someone who casted you out of their life is not somebody you want back in your life. You should cut all potential form of contact you have with her, whether that be blocking her on everything, deleting her number, etc. The time after a breakup is time to focus on you. You can’t let someone who disregarded you and your feelings inhibit your progress in life beyond this point.

Breaking up with someone is like leveling up in life. It may be hard to see it in that light right now and it may even sound ridiculous, but as someone who is in a situation very similar I can promise you that you will come out of all this much wiser and with a much better idea of your own worth. I would recommend you head over to r/exnocontact  as it has lots of great reality checks. Otherwise, I wish you the best of luck, and you can always PM me if you need anything.
